==Training Hitpoints alone==
[[Skill pure]]s (also known as skillers) or other accounts who wish to train Hitpoints without training other combat skills have a few options. [[Experience lamp]]s from [[random events]], [[Uncleaned find|cleaning finds]] in the [[Varrock Museum]], completing [[Achievement Diaries]], etc. can be applied to Hitpoints. They can also participate in the [[Pest Control]] and [[Soul Wars]] minigames and spend reward points on Hitpoints experience, although both require combat levels to enter. [[Training manual]]s from the [[Intelligence Gathering|tackling organised crime]] minigame can also be used for Hitpoints experience, although some combat is required to receive them.

The [[Witch's House]] quest can be completed using only [[rings of recoil]], and awards 6325 Hitpoints XP. [[Observatory Quest]] also ''may'' reward Hitpoints XP--the reward is chosen randomly from a list of several options.
